CheckTitle: Provisioned apps have user deactivation pushed downstream
Description: Checks provisioned apps enable downstream user deactivation.
Risk: Provisioned apps that do not receive deactivation can retain access after an Okta user is deactivated.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Applications > Applications.
2. Open the provisioned app integration and select Provisioning.
3. Open To App settings and click Edit.
4. Enable Deactivate User for the app integration.
5. Save, then test deactivation with a non-production user before relying on it for offboarding.

Recommendation.Text: Enable downstream user deactivation for provisioned apps so departed or unassigned users lose access outside Okta.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
